decisions.reason: Its proven government deployment and extensive APIS connectivity make it a core, credible part of our aviation and border-security portfolio.
Cyber security awareness training remains a scalable cross-sell that fits our training capabilities, though it is less differentiated than our core operational security products.
Behaviour analysis remains strategically relevant for high-risk environments, but its likely longer sales cycles and harder proof of return raise the risk somewhat.
The document verification web platform is close to our core offer and well suited to transport and border-related clients, supporting continued commitment.
